info.title: OpenMic External API v2
info.description:
The OpenMic External API (v2) provides programmatic access to agents, calls,
phone numbers, tools, contact lists, campaigns, and voices.

## Authentication
All endpoints require an API key passed as a Bearer token in the
`Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>
```

## Rate Limiting
Most endpoints are limited to **100 requests per minute** per organization.
The `POST /create-phone-call` endpoint has a stricter limit of **5 requests per minute**.

agents.name: Sales Agent
agents.prompt: You are a helpful sales agent...

post.description:
Creates a new voice AI agent.

> **Note:** `first_message` and `auto_first_message` are mutually exclusive. Providing both returns a `400` error.

example.name: Support Agent
example.prompt: You are a friendly customer support agent for Acme Corp.
example.first_message: Hello! How can I help you today?

get.description: Returns the full details of a single agent.

patch.description:
Partially updates an agent. Only the fields you include are modified.

Set `knowledge_base_id` to `null` to detach the current knowledge base.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an agent.

Returns `409 Conflict` if the agent is currently linked to a phone number or campaign.

post.description:
Initiates a new outbound phone call from a number registered in your organization.

**Rate limit:** 5 requests per minute.

get.description: Returns details and current status of a single call by its CUID.
Returns a cursor-paginated list of calls, newest first.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Filter calls on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Filter calls on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of phone numbers in your organization.
Returns details for a single phone number including linked agents.

post.summary: Link an agent to a phone number
post.description:
Associates an agent with a phone number for the given `direction`.

| Direction | Effect |
|-----------|--------|
| `inbound` | Agent handles incoming calls on this number |
| `outbound` | Agent is used as the default for outbound calls from this number |
| `both` | Both directions |

post.summary: Unlink an agent from a phone number
post.description: Removes the agent association from a phone number for the given direction.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of tools attached to the agent.

post.summary: Create a tool for an agent
post.description:
Adds a new tool to the agent's toolset.

When `type` is `api_request`, the `url` field is **required**.

post.description:
Creates a new outbound dialing campaign.

The campaign will begin dialing contacts within the `time_start`–`time_end` window on the specified `days`. If `timezone` is omitted the organization's default timezone is used.

patch.description: Partially updates a campaign. Only the fields you include are modified.

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated catalogue of available voices.
Use the `voice` field from a voice record when creating or updating an agent.
Returns details for a single voice by its numeric ID.
